# defectdojo_cicd_infrastructure (Resource)

Manages a DefectDojo CI/CD infrastructure object: a source code management server, build server or orchestration engine, which engagements link to with `cicd_scm_server_id`, `cicd_build_server_id` and `cicd_orchestration_engine_id`. Managing these objects needs a superuser or the CI/CD infrastructure configuration permissions, including the view or change permission: without them, DefectDojo ignores `description` and `url`, and the apply fails with an inconsistent result.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "defectdojo_cicd_infrastructure" "github" {
  name                = "GitHub"
  infrastructure_type = "scm_server"
  url                 = "https://github.com"
}

resource "defectdojo_cicd_infrastructure" "jenkins" {
  name                = "Jenkins"
  infrastructure_type = "build_server"
  description         = "The main build server."
  url                 = "https://jenkins.example.com"
}

resource "defectdojo_cicd_infrastructure" "kubernetes" {
  name                = "Production cluster"
  infrastructure_type = "orchestration"
}

# An engagement links to one object of each type.
resource "defectdojo_engagement" "pipeline" {
  product_id      = 7
  name            = "CI pipeline"
  engagement_type = "CI/CD"
  target_start    = "2026-01-01"
  target_end      = "2026-12-31"

  cicd_scm_server_id           = defectdojo_cicd_infrastructure.github.id
  cicd_build_server_id         = defectdojo_cicd_infrastructure.jenkins.id
  cicd_orchestration_engine_id = defectdojo_cicd_infrastructure.kubernetes.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `infrastructure_type` (String) The type of the object: `scm_server`, `build_server` or `orchestration`. DefectDojo can't change it, so changing it replaces the object.
- `name` (String) The name of the object, unique among the objects of its type. At most 200 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the object, at most 2000 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes.
- `url` (String) The public http, https, ftp or ftps URL of the tool, at most 2000 characters, such as `https://jenkins.example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the CI/CD infrastructure object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = defectdojo_cicd_infrastructure.example
  identity = {
    id = 3
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) ID of the CI/CD infrastructure object

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# CI/CD infrastructure objects are imported by their numeric ID
terraform import defectdojo_cicd_infrastructure.example <id>
```
